label: AU-10(2)
title: Validate Binding of Information Producer Identity

children.label: (a)
children.prose: Validate the binding of the information producer identity to the information at {{ insert: param, au-10.02_odp.01 }} ; and

children.label: (b)
children.prose: Perform {{ insert: param, au-10.02_odp.02 }} in the event of a validation error.

guidance: Validating the binding of the information producer identity to the information prevents the modification of information between production and review. The validation of bindings can be achieved by, for example, using cryptographic checksums. Organizations determine if validations are in response to user requests or generated automatically.

params.label: frequency
guidelines: the frequency at which to validate the binding of the information producer identity to the information is defined;

params.label: actions
guidelines: the actions to be performed in the event of a validation error are defined;
